name: Young Peacekeeper's static +1 POWER and +1 LIFE while fostered
notes: Same reasoning as imperial-recruit-fostered-power: 'Fostered' is a plain persistent TurnEffect, so the static +1 POWER/+1 LIFE while fostered can be tested directly by patching TurnEffects at setup.

rulesClauses: Young Peacekeeper gets +1 POWER and +1 LIFE as long as it's fostered.
